name: kadenz-native
comment: The `firebase` JS SDK is an optional peer of @capacitor-firebase/messaging and is deliberately absent: it is only used by that plugin's web platform, and on the web Kadenz sends push with VAPID through web-push instead. Adding it would pull a large unused dependency and pin us to its major version.
description: Capacitor shell wrapping the Kadenz web front end for iOS and Android
